notes: Home has a Share card that works any time: today, this week, last week or the last 30 days, a workout you just finished, or your own words. The weekly and monthly summaries show up there when they are ready. A new Recipes card lets you tweak the smoothie or recovery drink, write your own, and share it as an image. Palms and fists now score as high fives and fist bumps. Snacks now tally one tap at a time. Sauna, cold and the other perks score once a day, with up to two sessions logged. No changes to your data or app address.
